sourceRefs.locator: Opening section Wulfila, excerpt of Philostorgius, Ecclesiastical History 2.5 in Photius’ epitome, followed by the conditional calculation of 347–348.
Chapter 1, discussion immediately before §1.5 and §1.5 on the division of translation work and the codices; §2.1, table 2.1, on letter shapes, order and numeral values.

summary.de: Alphabet der gotischen Bibelhandschriften. Reihenfolge, Zahlenwerte und zahlreiche Buchstabenformen lassen ein griechisches Vorbild erkennen.
summary.en: Alphabet of the Gothic biblical manuscripts. The sequence, numeral values and many letter shapes point to a Greek model.
